scope: Read-only source and already-written aggregate summaries; no model loaded, no new sampling, no train/dev/test record read in this audit.
conclusion: No identified H4-to-H5 log-sigma/axis/scaling/epsilon-target mismatch in inspected paths. This is not proof of correct run execution or a cause for smoke overflow. All three VAE formal runs remain held until bound known-checkpoint parity and feasibility review.

comparisons.finding: logs is log standard deviation, never log variance: z=mu+epsilon*exp(logs); Normal scale=exp(logs). No factor0.5 belongs in inherited path.
Old FVAE wrapper transposes encoder B16x48 to B48x16, then runner stack and permute returns Bx2x16x48. H5 stacks direct encoder output into Bx2x16x48. Channel0=mu,channel1=logsigma.

Train-only population zscore for actual global/residue descriptors; constant columns scale1; residue padding appended as zero after transform; global abs before encoder. Old float32 abs vs H5 float64 abs then encoder float32 cast has same intended numerical boundary. No posterior standardization is present.

Both use raw mu/logsigma tensor x0, xt=sqrt(abar_t)*x0+sqrt(1-abar_t)*epsilon, objective MSE(pred,epsilon). t drawn1..998 from999-step schedule. No latent standardizer or inverse transform is used in either pipeline.

Same linear beta1e-4..0.02/999, cumulative alpha product, reverse998..1, conditional epsilon prediction, ancestral beta variance noise (zero final noise). H5 divides and adds in two statements with same ordered operations. Pure terminal conditional call, no classifier-free guidance blend.

DDPM models encoder posterior parameters q(z|sequence,descriptors), so sampled z goes directly to decoder. The inverse conditional flow belongs to the distinct empirical_condition_flow_prior method; no inverse-flow omission is identified for posterior_parameter_ddpm.

Inherited EMA helper copies current model until update2000; at1000 updates EMA checkpoint equals current parameters by helper behavior. Same conditional UNet source imported with source-manifest verification.

Scalar retains legacy scalar MSE/nonPAD and sampled density sum/16. CE21/MSE21 both use sampled density sum/(B48), different from scalar. CE-vs-MSE is objective-component contrast; scalar-vs-CE remains whole-pipeline comparison, not single-component attribution.

observed_aggregate_evidence.scope_limit: Old and fresh models, training duration and generation seeds differ; range differences cannot establish causal undertraining.
